intro.text: 03:07 AM The queries are still running... (I wish I shouldn't wait all the time...)

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: THIS IS NO SENSE! Nobody reads these dashboards anyway SQL is just something fancy for people in suits who never actually follow the data recommendations...

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I'm exhausted. My eyes are in pain.. my body feels so heavy...I'll..... I'll just close my eyes for a bit... until the queries are ready... until...

According to the medical report: Ada was found not breathing over her desk at 8:00 AM by her colleagues. There were no family, friends or cat to report the situation. The cause of her death is still under investigation, testifies said something was still running in the computer.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Grass? Fresh Air? What's happening?! What are this clothes?! Why the sky looks like a table? Why does it have so many columns?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Surprising right? Iseakais are real after all. Sorry, welcome to the Kingdom of Code little witch. Here the world is a database, and magic is runs by querying.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: A Grimoire. Now listen, in this world magic must written. Every spell is a query. FANTASTIC isn't it?

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I write SQL all day. How bad it can be?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Let's just say that your whole survival depends on this now. And because I want to see you live. Before you meet the dangers of the world, practice against this dummy.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Ada, you must know my pages are small only four rows can fit. When you use your spells  you must pay with your mana, but only four rows will actually be cast.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Never written a query? In battle, just press F3 or click GUIDE: It will show you what to write, and how to read my pages.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: And you will learn the rest from the first thing that wants to eat you.
...What's that?! Something round and green wobbles out of the bushes: is..the ASTERISK SLIME!

battle_tip: New to SQL? Press F3 for the spell guide.
victory: The Asterisk Slime melts into a puddle of rows.
Ada: One word. LIMIT. And the page behaves.
defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Slime wobbles triumphantly.
Grimoire: Even the best witches overflow sometimes. Again?

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: LIMIT is yours, witch, used to get mana and keep casting spells. You still have to meet the guardians. The next guardian is not beaten with random spells, but with the right ones. Be wise, Witch.
The Filter Door. A castle that only allows who is worth to get in. Protected by the Guardian Sir Wherewell

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Stop! The Knight of the Filter is here. You won't cross my lady.

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Only a spell of the element...I won't tell you. Only a spell of the element I am weak to cross inside. Now get out on peace or accept a cruel destiny.

knight_intro.speaker: Ada
knight_intro.text: Oh really? Do you think I'm afraid of you? Well, let's figure it out, funny can man.

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: Witch Listen. He's not a cupcake, if you want to breach his defense you must find his weakness and call spells from the same type. He'll try to do the same with you, he never casts without WHERE.

knight_victory: Sir Wherewell kneels and opens the gate.
Ada: WHERE is the entrance sir? ;)
knight_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Knight lowers his blade.
Grimoire: Spells that are not super-effective bounce off. Filter for his weakness.
end_of_slice: End of the vertical slice. Thank you for playing!
